slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Two angles are complementary if their measures add to 90 degrees and supplementary if they add to 180 degrees.

Theorem: complements of the same angle are equal, and supplements of the same angle are equal.

Proof (supplements): if angles 1 and 3 are both supplementary to angle 2, then m1 + m2 = 180 and m3 + m2 = 180. By substitution m1 + m2 = m3 + m2, and subtracting m2 gives m1 = m3.
